name: Kennedy
summary: Kennedy reveals the intimate lives, loves, rivalries, and tragedies that shaped the most iconic dynasty in modern history, and helped create the world we live in today. Beginning in the 1930s, the first season charts the improbable ascent of Joe and Rose Kennedy and their nine children, including the rebellious second son, Jack, who struggles to escape the shadow of his golden-boy older brother.

name: Furious
summary: Furious follows an FBI agent, Alice Black, on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

name: De week van Merijn
summary: This satirical series features comedian and actor Merijn Scholten, in various guises, taking viewers on a slightly absurdist journey through the confusing zeitgeist. Sometimes harsh, sometimes gentle, but always with a deep love for the species to which we belong. And looking beyond the Randstad.

name: Startime
summary: Ford Startime (aka Lincoln-Mercury Startime) was an hour long, color anthology series sponsored by the automotive company. Music, variety and drama alternated in various programs over the course of the one season it aired. Many top stars appeared. Hubbell Robinson was the Executive Producer for the series which had a reported budget of 15 million dollars for the season. There was also a Canadian version of the series on the CBC that aired a few of the American programs in addition to their own productions.

name: Armorsaurs
summary: In a near future where a hostile alien force threatens Earth with prehistoric war beasts, a secret defense program is initiated in which teenage pilots are genetically linked to a variety of dinosaur companions equipped with advanced battle armor. An adaptation of the South Korean series Armored Saurus by Daewon Media.

name: Fixer Upper: Colorado Mountain House
summary:
Fixer Upper: Colorado Mountain House, Chip and Joanna take on a 1960s mountain property in Colorado, tackling unique design and construction hurdles that come with high-altitude living. Together, they blend original mid-century details with European-inspired finishes, transforming the home into their own timeless family retreat nestled in the Rockies. 

Viewers will watch the Gaineses navigate everything from creating spaces ideal for a multi-generational family gathering, to surprise visits from local wildlife, to uncovering unique architectural details. With plenty of surprises along the way, Fixer Upper: Colorado Mountain House captures the signature heart, humor, and design vision that fans have come to love, set against a brand-new backdrop.

name: Невеста для MBAND
summary: Previously, the band's female fans had the unique chance to spend a day with their idols: a chance to learn about the guys' lives, how they record songs, how they prepare for performances, how they relax, and what they argue about. And now, the members of MBAND are back! They have it all—fame, money, and hordes of female fans. But they still haven't found the most important thing in life... LOVE! In the new season, STS Love will solve this problem and find partners for the most eligible and desirable bachelors in show business. Thousands of girls will have the chance to win the hearts of these bandits and hear them say, "I'd give everything in the world for just one glance from you!"

name: Модная полиция
summary: The host of the "Fashion Police" project on the STS Love channel, renowned stylist Ivan Vasiliev follows current fashion trends and offers practical advice on makeup, choosing clothes for any occasion, and also shares little professional tricks.

name: Pandora - A szelence átka
summary: Pandora - The Curse of the Box is a brand new strategic reality show hosted by the outstanding actor Gábor Hevér. Sixteen celebrities, including Mónika Ullmann, Linda Király, Laci Gáspár, and Jani Vadon, take on a game reminiscent of Greek mythology, featuring challenges of skill, logic, and strategy. The winner of the show, which is being premiered in Hungary, will receive a fabulous grand prize of up to 50 million forints.

name: Короли дня
summary: "Kings of the Day" is more than just a show; it's a television magazine that will help viewers manage their time, gain self-confidence, learn how to meet the challenges of everyday life, offer fashion tips, and suggest unexpected life hacks. The show's host, actress Anna Tsukanova-Kott, known for her roles in the TV series "The Eighties," the film "Brest Fortress," and more, will team up with invited experts and celebrities to find unusual solutions to everyday situations. Guests on "Kings of the Day" will include TV host Artyom Korolev, bloggers Anastasia Reshetova, Natalya Yashchuk, Ida Galich, Karina Nigay, Polina Trubenkova, Roma Zhelud, singer Hanna, Anna Shulgina, and many others. The guests will tell viewers how to emerge victorious from even the most unfortunate day, from one when it seems like your whole life is a misunderstanding. They will share their stories from life and teach viewers how to find solutions to absolutely any situation.

name: Моя свадьба лучше!
summary: Have you ever seen four enraged brides ready to beat each other up to prove their wedding is the best? Domashny TV presents the first and only wedding reality show on Russian television about how to get married and throw the most spectacular celebration that will make everyone envious. Every week, four women attend each other's weddings and evaluate their rivals' events on four criteria: the bride's look, the menu, the guest entertainment, the wedding concept, and its execution. A chocolate fountain, New Year's Eve in mid-July, and even a real elephant—what lengths won't the women go to beat their competitors and win the grand prize—a honeymoon in a fabulous exotic land? On the fifth day, a panel of experts, including supermodel Elena Kuletskaya and wedding expert Lika Dlugach, tally the scores and announce the winner. But "My Wedding Is Better" isn't all intrigue, bitter truths, and unexpected disappointments! In each program, brides-to-be and current brides will receive invaluable advice on planning the perfect wedding. Should you spend a fortune or will a bright and unique idea suffice? How do you choose the perfect wedding dress? What contests should you hold? Will guests have fun if you forgo alcohol? Find answers to these and many other pressing questions in the new super show "My Wedding Is Better" on the Domashny TV channel!

name: 80 Grand
summary: The talented hairdresser Bousi is going through financial difficulties and has to raise 80 thousand pounds in order to afford getting married. The salon owner decides to help her work as a private hairdresser who visits clients in their homes. She's introduced to another world that she had never seen before, while her fiancé tries to help her complete the required amount.

name: Sons of the Sun
summary: After living a harsh life in an orphanage, Welaa and Moftah decide to reject that life and rebel against it, especially after they are forced to steal and swindle by the director of the orphanage, Maged, who then declares war on them, and they try to get rid of him and protect the rest of the orphans from his evil.

name: Encountering Love
summary: After a wealthy woman discovers that her husband has cheated on her and married another, she decides to separate from him and searches for a new romance, but she gets involved in various conflicts that she did not expect, and her life gradually changes along the way.

name: My Sisters
summary: Trapped in a toxic marriage, Nagla dreams that her husband died—only to later find his corpse at her doorstep. With the mystery engulfing her, she turns to her three sisters for a way out.

name: Sharbat Loaz
summary: The series tells the story of (Sharbat) who is a divorced seamstress. She lives in a humble area and supports her younger brothers. She then marries a rich fashion designer and events escalate.

name: Soliman's Ring
summary: Despite his success as a surgeon, Suleiman is a humble man with a spontaneous inclination. When he is put under tremendous pressure, the course of his life changes after a major shock.

name: I Spy, You Spy
summary: Join Elsee as she explores the world with her new friends, spying new things, enjoying the sights, and having lots of fun along the way!

name: Xing Yi Shan He Zhi Huo Li Quan Kai
Mwy Neu Lai
summary: Welsh-language schools TV series for infants and pre-schoolers.

name: KochinPa!
summary: Anime adaptation of pachinko and slot machine parlor Island's "Aira Project" commercials. It follows three mascot characters: Aira, Hana, and Shima.

name: Близкое счастье
summary: Ruslan Adamov, a young businessman, owns the shopping center "Near Happiness" in Antalya. After his wife's death, Ruslan devoted himself to his son and his work, and despite his popularity with girls, he did not start a serious relationship. One day, a Russian girl, Nina, appears in his store. Her foster parents' house burned down, and now she desperately needs a job. Seeing the potential in the girl, Ruslan takes her in. Nina turns out to be extremely talented: her suggestions surprise Adamov and benefit the business. Young people realize that they are seriously falling in love with each other, but circumstances are playing against them.

name: Эльбрус
summary:
At the center of the story is Viktor Kostrov, a widower and former rescuer of the Ministry of Emergency Situations. After the death of his wife, he brings up the twins Katya and Ivan. At the invitation of his comrade-in-arms Aslan, he comes to visit the southern city and stays here forever to start a new life. He opened a small business and organized a rescue group, which included his children.

 The "nose" and "ears" of the squad are a golden retriever, he was once rescued from poachers, and since then the dog has become a devoted friend, a full–fledged member of the rescue squad and a mascot. Together, the squad members and their irreplaceable tailed assistant help tourists or extreme athletes out of trouble and help the local police. Major Anatoly Lapshin interacts with rescuers more often. And all the heroes of this story defy dangers, solve complicated crimes and come to the aid of all those who find themselves in trouble.

name: Inside the Arrest
summary:
Inside the Arrest captures the moment of arrest, conducted more than two thousand times a day by British police, in order to investigate or prevent a crime. The arrest is the start point for every story, a high-stakes moment that can be met with anything from violence to defiance, confession to incredulity.

Each episode features two cases using police bodycam footage to analyse some notorious and high-profile arrests from recent years.

name: Гардероб навылет
summary: Professional stylists Timur Guchkaev and Maxim Rapoport help women find their unique fashion look. In the program, participants choose each other's wardrobe for a special event or holiday, relying solely on their own taste and feminine intuition.

name: Ангелы красоты
summary: Is work draining you, is there no time for yourself, and is looking in the mirror terrifying and sad? Domashny's "Beauty Angels" will transform "mousy gray women" into gorgeous ladies in just one day! The "Beauty Angels" project—the magnificent Aurora, renowned designer Konstantin Gaidai, and leading showbiz stylists—is accepting applications for magical transformations and, in just one episode, teaching the participants how to dress properly, take care of themselves, and see life differently. Life stories, helpful tips, and unexpected looks from the most ordinary women—in Domashny's premiere.

name: Красота требует!
summary: The "Beauty Demands!" program will prove that being beautiful is easy! The transformations experienced by the project's participants are a great incentive for the female audience to transform themselves. In one of the segments, a mother and daughter or two friends will try their hand at stylists and try to create looks for each other. Afterward, Timur will share his advice, correct any mistakes, and find the perfect compromise. At the end of the program, a pleasant surprise awaits the participant: carefully selected outfits will be given as a gift!

name: Свидание для мамы
summary: Now single moms don't have to worry about their children disliking their chosen one. On the show "Domennyy Beau" (Home Beau), the kids themselves will choose their mom's boyfriend. On the program "Date for Mom," everyone wins. Moms will be convinced of their own attractiveness: after all, there are at least six candidates for every mom! The kids will have a blast: from five or six candidates, they will choose two for a date. And the candidates will have a chance to please both their kids and their mom right away. How will this encounter end? And will the moms agree with their children's choice?

name: Битва талантов
summary: The most talented children from across the CIS who successfully passed the audition will participate in the reality show "Battle of Talents." Each episode will be judged by a new trio of celebrity judges: popular artists, composers, and bloggers. Only two celebrity mentors will accompany the teams from the beginning to the end of the show. The "Battle" set design deserves special attention, as it will be one of the most ambitious in the history of reality TV projects. The grand prize for the winner who passes all the tests will be one million rubles for further promotion!

name: Deadline
summary: Marion, a nurse addicted to opiates, gets hired in a palliative care unit (USP), to gain access to a pharmacy containing an inexhaustible supply of drugs. She doesn't care about the patients. She's incurred a €15,000 debt with Victor, a dealer inventive when it comes to torturing late payers. Her plan: raid the pharmacy to pay Victor back quickly. However, our heroine hasn't planned for one thing. The USP patients are not blind and have nothing to lose. To fulfill a final wish, some are ready to do anything, even blackmail. So when her scheme is discovered, Marion finds herself caught between the threat of Victor and that of being denounced. Marion will quickly discover that the wishes of the dying are far from easy to fulfill. Forced to put herself at the service of her patients, Marion will gradually reveal the secret of her past. Marion's time will turn into shock therapy as she will find herself confronted with what drugs have deprived her of: a torrent of emotions.

name: Родительский контроль
summary: "Parental Control" is a reality show in which teenagers go to work for a day and put themselves in their parents' shoes, trying to understand firsthand where the money comes from in their home! Each episode features a new family and new challenges. Will the characters be able to understand each other and find common ground?

name: Домашняя кухня
summary: Tired of watching culinary masterpieces you can't make at home? On the popular cooking show on the Domashny TV channel, chef Lara Katsova will share the secrets of simple yet exquisite dishes!

name: Поющий офис
summary: In each episode, employees from offices across the country will showcase their vocal talents. The winner will be determined by audience vote.

name: Однажды в милиции
summary: The series takes place in a "backwater" police station in a certain metropolis. The station is held in low regard by its superiors and, consequently, serves as a place of exile for all offending police officers. The series' protagonists are the station's employees. The plot revolves around their relationships and the events of their professional and personal lives.

name: June Farms
summary:
Farm owner and restaurateur Matt Baumgartner, an accomplished but demanding entrepreneur, who runs the farm, restaurant/bar and events space with the help of a team of well-intentioned 20-somethings who aren't always on the same page as their detail-obsessed boss. 

Matt Baumgartner, owner of June Farms, wants to make it the premiere event space in the Hudson Valley. He has his hands full every week delivering perfect bespoke weddings. With a young, vibrant staff of varying personalities, at times more focused on their love lives than their jobs and inclement weather, this wedding season turned out to be the hardest one in June Farms' history.

name: Dark Light
summary: It seems like an accidental encounter in a bar, but Qin Yu Lin, the driver of Xingyao Group, lies in the bed of Xu En Xin, the daughter of Fenghua Chamber of Commerce. Xu En Xin is deeply attracted to Qin Yu Lin and asks Zhou Xing Han, the president of Xingyao Group, for him, so he becomes her exclusive driver. He will silently remember all her preferences, will hand her just the right amount of coffee when she is tired, and will be the first to stand in front of her when danger comes. Xu En Xin gradually finds that she is becoming more and more dependent on this driver.

name: Summer Waves and You
summary: Li Sui An, a peasant girl from Honggu Village, has no parents and wants to find a husband to live a stable life. However, she has been on many blind dates and has been frustrated by the frequent appearance of bad men. Until a new neighbor appears, he has a thin waist, long legs, and is extremely handsome. Li Sui An is attracted to him at first sight and decides to marry him home, letting him take care of his beauty while she takes care of earning money to support the family.

name: Guai Guai Ru Ju, He Shao Fang Si Jiao Chong
summary: Jiang Yu grew up in Yangcheng, a city with continuous rain all year round. She inherited all her grandfather's inheritance, but was locked up in a wooden building by the Song family, pretending to be crazy and living a miserable life, leaving her to rot on her own. In order to seek revenge, she left the old house and set her sights on He Lian, the prince of Jinzhou, and set up a trap for him.

name: Accidental Noble Husband
summary: Su Ke Ke and her mother run a snack bar. Ke Ke is engaged to Qiao Yu Fan, an employee of the Pei Group. During a meal delivery, she witnesses Yu Fan cheating on her with the Pei Group executive Jiang Xiao Yuan. Drowning her sorrows at night, she runs into Pei Yan, Pei Group's CEO, who is framed by his brother Pei Yu because of the fight for inheritance. However, Yan loses his memory after waking up, and his temperament changes drastically. Su Ke Ke names Yan "Lucky." Because Ke Ke's mother is seriously ill, she wants to find a husband for Ke Ke. So, Ke Ke and Yan have a sudden marriage.

name: Helpless without You
summary: Yu Tian Dong, who suffers from various mental illnesses, falls in love with his psychological counselor, Nan Xing. The ten months they spend together are extremely agonizing for Xing. After leaving Tian Dong in a cruel manner, Xing is always uneasy about whether he will take revenge, but he disappears for two years. Just when she thinks she has completely gotten rid of him, he reappears on her wedding day and kidnaps her husband, Su Mu, to threaten her into a divorce. For Mu's safety, she has no choice but to be in Tian Dong's clutches again. From then on, she has only one goal in life: to get rid of Tian Dong for good, even if it means she has to escape to outer space. When Xing finally comes up with a way to be rid of Tian Dong completely, she realizes that she has become more dependent on him than she thinks...

name: How Can We Resist Her Charm
summary: As a nanny, Gu Ci only did two things around Jiang Qi Yun, to please him and to please his son. In daily life, Jiang Qi Yun found that Gu Ci's smiles and frowns gradually overlapped with the girl in his memory, and the past slowly emerged.

name: Debauchery
summary: One is anxious and eager for life-saving money; the other is ambitious and frantically needs to be promoted. And so a deal was born. She was originally just a pawn, but during the transaction, the two couldn't help but fall in love with each other...

previousepisode.name: Secret Rendezvous Between a Cat and a Dog

name: Jobb később, mint soha!
summary: The location of this fiction reality comedy is Japan and Thailand. Four not too young, legendary actor - Sándor Badár, Imre Csuja, Attila Epres and Péter Scherer - and their loyal "weapon bearer", the famous hairdresser Fecó Frohner would like to prove that openness, curiosity and the love of life are not depend on your age.

name: Physical: Asia
summary: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.

name: La Comtesse de Monte-Cristo
summary: After her sailor fiancé is wrongly imprisoned in 1815 Marseille, a determined woman's rescue attempt ends in tragedy, leading her down a path of vengeance against powerful conspirators.

name: Сімʼя по неділях
summary: The plot centres on the Romanchuk family, typical Ukrainians with their weaknesses and habits. The head of the family spent twenty years working in Italy and now returns home with a decision: Sunday dinners must become mandatory for all family members. He is confident that these gatherings will help revive family ties and restore lost warmth. However, in practice, these dinners turn into not peaceful conversations, but real comedic battles with many curious situations, misunderstandings, and unexpected confessions.

name: Punch Punch Forever!
summary: Gogo Matsumoto an 11-year old aloof martial arts prodigy, along with her half-demon older sister; Nono, her mama; Mama, and her cool pet frog; Coolfrog, competes in a martial arts tournament pitting humans against demons from another realm.

name: Ховаючи колишню
summary: Four strangers meet at the funeral of a woman they all once dated — a soldier who died on the front line. She invited them to be there, but why? At her favorite bar, their stories about her slowly shift into stories about themselves.

name: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper's Nightwatch
summary: Siblings Daisy May and Charlie Cooper sleep over at the UK's spookiest places... hopefully alone. What secrets will emerge and will they still be talking to each other by dawn?

name: Secrets of Supercheap Shopping
summary: A behind-the-scenes look at how discount disruptors are leading the charge in the bargain revolution. How are they saving us money and bagging such good deals?

name: Тайный город
summary: Artyom, an IT specialist, accidentally becomes the owner of a magical artifact and discovers a different Moscow, where powerful sorcerers and magicians live hiding from human eyes. This alternative capital is governed by three Great Houses: Nav, Chud and After All. Artyom finds himself in the very center of their confrontation, as a result of which his life changes forever.

name: Очень древняя Русь
summary: The series is about today's life, transferred to the scenery of the XIII century. Here, instead of fabulous antiquity, there are witty anachronisms: a "beauty camp" with "lip stinging" procedures operates in the village, horses are "understated" and given "cast" horseshoes, and the cellular connection is replaced by "Vestilo" — children who carry the news.

name: Нейровася
summary: The brutal Russian cop Vasya lives by his own concepts and does not recognize technology. However, fate brings him together with the artificial intelligence svt 1,9, or simply Sveta. Vasya tries to get rid of the imposed "partner", but eventually realizes that Sveta not only helps him solve crimes, but also gives him a chance to figure out his own life. An unusual couple investigates new cases, encountering curiosities, conflicts and unexpected discoveries.

name: Повар под прикрытием
summary: Nadia, a chef with thirty years of experience, runs a cozy dining room next to the police station. Her son, Pasha, works as an operative and helps his mother with business — police officers often come to her for a bite of homemade food. One day, the police find out that an influential businessman is looking for a new personal chef — and this is a chance to get as close to him as possible. To help her son and his colleagues solve the case, Nadia decides to infiltrate the suspect's house, disguised as a cook, and find herself in the very center of events.

name: Гуляй, шальная!
summary:
Major Elizabeth Kiver, is coming to the city of Krasnov. Krasnovsky district has long lost a strong hand: the operas are lazy and cynical, the duty officer sleeps on duty, and the detection statistics are flying into the abyss. But Elizabeth Kiver is a charismatic, strong—willed, but vulnerable woman who never gives up and knows how to hold a punch, even if the whole world is against her. 

From the very first days, Lisa understands that her subordinates are a special category of people: opera Colban, who is in eternal conflict with sobriety, Maxim is a cunning man and a lover of "earning extra money" in any way, and Vanya is a romantic dog driver without a dog. Together they become a source of endless catastrophes, ridiculous situations and poignant moments, but gradually it is this motley team that begins to become a family.

name: Hollyoaks Does Come Dine With Me
summary: To celebrate 30 years of the soap, Hollyoaks stars Isabelle Smith, Anya Lawrence, Charlie Wernham, James Redmond and Nicole Barber-Lane take it in turns to throw a dinner party.

name: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
summary: An investigation into a viral prison sex tape leads journalist Mobeen Azhar to discover an illicit prison economy fuelled by inappropriate relationships, coercion and contraband.

name: Mary at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
summary: Happy birthday! Mary Berry is joined by famous friends to share memories and recipes. Celebrating the joy of food, they'll revisit old favourites and discover new delicious dishes.

name: Hollyoaks Later
summary: `Hollyoaks Later' is a spinoff of long-running soap opera `Hollyoaks'. The programme, which airs in a late-night time slot, delves deeper into the lives, loves and misdemeanours of some of the `Hollyoaks' characters, who shed their teen images as they try to find their feet away from the village. Due to its late-night schedule, `Hollyoaks Later' offers raunchier storylines and events than its parent programme, which airs earlier in the day.

name: Food For Lucking
summary: Near the courier station lies the Lohas Inn, a place that secretly gathers intelligence. The innkeeper, Tian Jinjin, is clever, alert, and kind-hearted; the waiter, Tian Dazhuang, is skilled in martial arts; the musician, Piao Daoyi, is knowledgeable and worldly; and the accountant, Madam Tian, has sharp eyes and an excellent memory. Each of the four harbors their own secrets, yet fate has brought them together. The high-spirited General Fu, demoted to the Central Post Station after offending a powerful noble, is in fact there to investigate a major case. Just as feelings begin to grow between him and Jinjin, an urgent border dispatch goes missing, and the courier is found murdered—plunging the entire city into turmoil.

name: Black Hole
summary: There's an old myth that haunts the seemingly perfect small town of Roosevelt: if you have sex too young, you'll contract the "bug," a virus that literally turns you into a "monster" from your worst nightmares. Absurd, right? That's what Chris always assumed, until, after one reckless night at the beginning of senior year, she finds herself infected. Now she'll be cast out to the woods to live with the other infected, where a chilling, new threat emerges: a serial killer who's hunting them one-by-one.

name: Shan Hun Tian Qi Jing Neng Gei Zong Cai Xu Ming
Checkpoint Charlie
summary: Military Police at Fort Stewart defend the gate with hilarious authority..

name: Cocaine Sisters
summary: What would make a loving mother, and a faithful wife turn to a life of crime? Find out in this moving drama as Alani navigates through love, loss, and poverty.

name: Modern Marvels: WWII
summary: Modern Marvels: WWII marks the return of the acclaimed franchise that has long celebrated the ingenuity, creativity, and engineering feats that surround us every day. This new limited series event expands the franchise's legacy, spotlighting the innovations that defined an era and changed the course of history. It will explore the greatest machines, most impactful weapons, and groundbreaking innovations of WWII, shining a light on the engineering and technological advances that shaped the course of the conflict and continue to influence our world today.

name: Cómplices
summary:
CÓMPLICES follows María José, Paula, Roberta, and Stacy four women working behind the scenes of a daytime talk show. Their lives take an unexpected turn when the show's producer, a man who has tormented them for years, is found dead. Suddenly, they become suspects in this crime. Though they maintain their innocence, this unforeseen situation becomes the spark that bonds them, inspiring them to rediscover themselves and embrace life with newfound freedom and humor.

The irreverent and empowering comedy doubles as a story of liberation, symbolically burying their past traumas and insecurities as they become true accomplices in their pursuit of happiness, love and fulfillment.

name: Beauty's Bone, Scarlet Sleeves
summary: After her parents are murdered by bandits posing as Imperial Guards, Dai Qingyin infiltrates the palace disguised as the courtesan Hongxiu to seek revenge. There, she falls for Xiao Yanhe—an emperor hiding his identity—and together they try to uncover true mastermind behind a royal conspiracy.

name: Switched Souls: The General's New Style
The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
summary: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.

name: A Journey of Promise and Remembrance
Ahora 360
summary: Ahora 360 will feature social, political and cultural stories along with dynamic conversations with newsmakers, thought leaders and personalities discussing a diverse range of issues impacting the Latino community.

name: If Wishes Could Kill
summary: The fears and dreams of teenagers caught between ambition and reality. Using the app is simple: upload a video of your wish and wait for it to come true — at a cost. What shocking truths will they uncover as they grapple with the consequences of their wishes?

name: Kingdom
summary: Kingdom will dramatically chronicle the real-life sagas of four African animal families, in one of the most ambitious projects ever undertaken by the BBC Studios Natural History Unit. Filmed across five years in a single spectacular location, the lives and fates of our four families – leopards, hyenas, wild dogs and lions – are inextricably linked as they strive for a foothold in a remote and fertile river valley in Zambia. As well as the intense power struggles between these top predators, the series shows how a colourful supporting cast, from powerful elephant herds to vast flocks of crimson bee-eaters to troops of marauding baboons, impact our central characters in surprising and diverse ways.

name: Доктор, у меня это
summary: In each episode, the hosts, along with viewers and invited guests—influencers and medical experts—explore a specific health topic in a confidential atmosphere, drawing on the most popular search queries among young people and the common myths associated with them.

name: Где снимали?
summary: The travel show "Where They Filmed" explores the locations of famous Russian films and TV series and uncovers interesting facts about the filming process at these locations.

previousepisode.name: Георгий Бессонов о фильмах, которые снимали в Якутии

name: Вызов Софико
summary: A new project by the Foundation for the Development of Scientific and Cultural Relations, "Challenge," is a journey into the world of ideas, where complex theories and the language of art take on new forms. Author and host Sofiko Shevardnadze invites outstanding scientists and renowned actors, directors, musicians, dancers, and theater critics to reflect on the present, past, and future. Together, the project's protagonists seek unexpected points of contact between significant discoveries and creative processes, while viewers get the chance to see our reality from a new perspective.

name: Монастыринг
summary:
Million-following bloggers became laborers at the Valaam Monastery.
They learned to work, pray, communicate with the monks, faced daily challenges, and overcame themselves.

name: Die Schatzinsel
summary: A terrible storm is raging the night it all begins with a knock on the door. 17-year-old Jim Hawkins helps his widowed mother run their little tavern on the coast of 19th-century England. When the door is opened they are startled by a sight that makes their blood run cold. The figure standing there is covered in scars and has a strange, insane glint in his eye. In the days that follow the grizzled old sailor, Bill Bones, spends hours on end staring out to sea until the day a crazed blind man at the head of a murderous gang of pirates tracks down Bill Bones--and murders him. All for a scrap of paper, Jim discovers to his amazement, but this scrap of paper is a map marking the location of fabulous buried treasure--gold, silver and jewels saved over the years by the ruthless, highly successful pirate, Captain Flint. It is hidden on a distant, mysterious island--and Jim manages to escape the furious pirates with the map. Now the prospect of finding such fantastic wealth exerts a magic spell on all and sundry. Soon Jim is part of an expedition alongside long-legged Long John Silver to find the treasure. At first the sea journey is an unfamiliar new adventure for Jim although he is fascinated by the charismatic Long John Silver. He quickly discovers that the crew Silver recruited is made up of fierce pirates--rough-and-ready brutal bandits who have sailed the seven seas in search of booty. The motley crew also includes 17-year-old Sheila, disguised as a ship's boy. The pretty young girl is pursuing the treasure for her own reasons: as Captain Flint's daughter, she believes that she alone is entitled to it, and she is prepared to go to any lengths to get the loot. But Jim Hawkins knows all too well that her life is worthless if Long John Silver and his men should discover her. As the Hispaniola sails on towards Treasure Island, Jim tries to gain Sheila's trust--to help her find the traces of her deceased father's life in the buried treasure. Thus the thrilling adventure begins, and Jim is exposed to a range of terrible ordeals--starting with mutiny. When our heroes finally reach the mysterious island, they find ample evidence of Captain Flint's gruesome deeds, including a crazed shipmate who was abandoned there years ago and is now intent on violent revenge. As the tale of treachery and pirate treasure unfolds, Jim is forced to grow up quickly--or die. As he survives thrilling adventures by the skin of his teeth, his experiences help him become a man. But will he find the treasure? Will Sheila obtain her inheritance? And how many of them will leave Treasure Island alive?

name: Seven Noon News
summary: Seven News live coverage of local, national and international news, plus sport, finance and weather updates.

name: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
summary: This series chronicles the lives of Rome's greatest gladiators - from Spartacus's defiant rebellion to Flamma's ultimate sacrifice in the arena. Their stories reveal the brutal rise and fall of gladiatorial combat, exposing how bloodsport shaped Roman power, culture, and identity. Through rebellion, spectacle, and survival, these warriors became legends in an empire built on violence and glory.

previousepisode.name: Flamma and the Death of the Games

name: The Show About the Show
summary: From award-winning director Caveh Zahedi, The Show About The Show is his self-referential scripted metaseries about a Brooklyn filmmaker trying to make a TV show. Co-starring Alex Karpovsky, Eleonore Hendricks, Dustin Defa and a who's who of Brooklyn's independent filmmaking community, the show tells the story of everything that can and does go wrong as Caveh tries to get a television series funded, produced, and distributed.

name: Me & Mickey
summary: Mickey invites preschoolers to play along as he talks about everyday topics familiar to their lives, including morning and nighttime routines and packing a backpack.

name: Don't Date Brandon
summary: A gripping true-crime docuseries that follows a modern romance that spiraled into a dangerous game of deception. When Amber starts dating Brandon after meeting him online, he seems like the perfect boyfriend. But when she connects with his ex-wife, Athena, everything is turned upside-down as they learn the truth together: Brandon is a manipulative liar with dark secrets.

name: Bad Influencer
summary: A single mother — and luxury bag counterfeiter — finds herself teaming up with a self-obsessed influencer to sell her bags and scrape her way out of debt.

name: Her Phoenix Majesty
summary: Scholar Xie Yuan wanders into a matriarchal kingdom where polyandry is practiced. His striking looks catch the eye of the Eldest Princess, who forcibly takes him to her palace to become her male consort. Refusing to submit, Xie Yuan plots his escape. On his flight, he encounters the seemingly kind and beautiful Second Princess, who offers help. What appears to be a chance meeting soon drags him into a web of courtly intrigue...

name: I Loved You in My Dreams
The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder
summary:
The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder exposes the disturbing truths that can lurk just beneath the surface of seemingly friendly communities. Featuring interviews with key individuals involved in the case, the investigators who searched for the truth, and the townspeople who still wrestle with the revelations this investigation exposed, this docuseries shows that no matter how hard people try to keep their secrets hidden, the truth has a way of always coming to light.  

In October 2012, Byron Griffy—respected mortician, devoted family man, and pillar of his rural Colorado community—was found dead on his remote ranch, shot execution-style. At first glance, it looked like a robbery gone wrong. But as detectives dug deeper, they discovered something far more twisted: an unthinkable betrayal and a tangled web of lies that exposed the town's darkest secrets.

name: A Bret Baier Interview
summary: Join Fox News' Bret Baier for exclusive interviews on what's happening inside the Beltway and on the world stage.

name: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
summary: From dark matter to black holes, stellar explosions to the absence of alien life, this mind-bending series will explore some of the universe's greatest enigmas.

name: Retten er satt
summary: Comedy program about fictional cases surrounding Norwegian celebs.

previousepisode.name: Henrik Thodesen mot Sophie Elise - dag 2

name: Heart Code
summary: The daughter of a powerful police officer has dodged assassination attempts and is now secretly in an elite training program. There, she meets a disciplined officer with sharp instincts. They're forced to share a room, and their chemistry starts to change. But political conspiracies, a hidden murder, and a complicated past threaten to tear them apart. When one finds out that the other's father might be connected to her own family's tragedy, their feelings are tested by duty, danger, and the cost of truth. They have to choose between justice and the love they never knew they had.

name: Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth
summary:
"Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth" examines the shocking story of Caroline Flack, "Love Island" presenter and one of Britain's biggest stars. After her arrest in 2019, she became the target of a relentless media storm. Vilified in the press and online, her world spiraled – ending in tragedy when she took her own life.

This powerful two-part  documentary follows Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months – uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days. With access to powerful testimony from Caroline's inner circle and those who were there, the series tells the story she never got to share and reveals an unprecedented look at what really happened to Caroline Flack.

name: Vantara: Sanctuary Stories
summary:
Hosted by renowned wildlife biologist, conservationist, and adventurer Forrest Galante, the six-episode series will take audiences on a visually stunning journey into Vantara, the world's largest wildlife rescue and rehabilitation facility that offers lifelong care for some of the most magnificent animals on Earth. 

Located in Gujarat, India, Vantara is a closed-to-the-public sanctuary designed for the wellbeing of the animals who live there. It is home to over one million animals, representing over 1000 species and is operated by a dedicated team of 25,000 employees. Now, for the first time ever, Galante offers an unprecedented look inside the walls of this extraordinary, not-for-profit sanctuary - a world very few have ever been allowed to enter.

name: Koi wa Ameagari no You ni: Pocket no Naka no Negaigoto
Guga por Kuerten
summary: Guga por Kuerten chronicles Guga's rise to the top, from his humble beginnings and the early death of his father to becoming a global tennis legend.

name: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
summary: David Rocco dives into trattorias, seaside markets, and back lane BBQs on an unapologetic journey through Italy where no bite is left behind.

name: Anything But Gray
summary: The show focuses on home makeovers that use bold colors and whimsical designs to create vibrant spaces. It follows Gray and her team as they surprise homeowners with dramatic renovations.

name: Life Like
summary: Disguised as the top courtesan of a famed nightclub, assassin Zhen Xu crosses paths by chance with Zhou Musheng, a member of the North City Chamber of Commerce on a secret mission. What begins as mutual deception soon turns into genuine affection as they navigate a world filled with danger and betrayal. Facing life-and-death trials together, they ultimately join forces to expose the Chamber's illicit dealings, and find a new beginning amid the ruins.

name: Cage of Shadows
summary: After her artisan family is brutally massacred, Nan Yanzhi becomes the disciple of Zhuang Wujiu. Under her guidance, she transforms from an innocent young woman into a ruthless survivor willing to crawl through the mud for revenge. Clinging to the few clues left behind, she infiltrates the mysterious Lingya Tower alone. Rumor has it that everyone who enters the tower is turned into a beast in its deadly arena, and none ever make it out alive. Just as Nan Yanzhi believes she has no one to rely on, she discovers that Zhuang Wujiu has appeared within Lingya Tower—as one of its highest rulers.

name: El futuro es nuestro
summary:
Year 2047. Ecological collapse has led to the creation of FedSur, a coalition of South American countries that applies extreme measures to protect nature and counteract the prevailing hunger and violence.

A new and captivating voice then emerges on the internet, a voice much more powerful than any other because it is capable of predicting the future. Police officer Hugo Crussí discovers that behind the voice is a young preacher named Jonás Flores, but his arrest causes him to become the spiritual leader of the continent overnight.

Forecasting the fall of FedSur and victory over climate change, Jonás will make the Latin American people dream and will get many to join his reactionary revolution. Meanwhile, Crussí, pursued as a member of the resistance, will embark on a suicidal mission to end the tyrant, who will have foreseen the assassination and will be waiting for him.

name: Buildings Beo
summary:
Buildings Beo is a property show with a difference: it's not only about the renovation of heritage buildings all around the country, but also about the people and the communities who bring these buildings to life. In this 6-part series, presenter Carrie Crowley takes a closer look at six inspiring projects across Ireland, where derelict architectural legacies are being preserved and transformed into vital community spaces.

With over 166,000 vacant buildings in Ireland today, BUILDINGS BEO sheds light on the urgent need for renewal of abandoned spaces. With projects ranging from historical mills to old schoolhouses, each episode follows the journey of a different restoration, showcasing the trials, tribulations and triumphs that come with preserving Ireland's architectural heritage.

Some of the remarkable restorations include the transformation of the historic Hope Castle Gate Lodge into a thriving community library in Castleblayney, Co. Monaghan, the revival of a railway building into a digital hub and youth centre in Ballinamore, Co. Leitrim, and the redevelopment of a fire-ravaged cinema into a state-of-the-art local theatre in Cork's market town of Macroom. Audiences will be wowed as each episode culminates in a final reveal, as all the hard work comes together and the building is brought back to life.

Throughout the series, Carrie meets with the builders, architects, and communities driving these restoration projects, offering viewers a behind-the-scenes look at the transformation process. Through compelling storytelling and stunning visuals, "Buildings Beo" celebrates Ireland's rich cultural and architectural heritage, demonstrating how it takes a village to make a Building BEO. Produced by New Departures Media.

previousepisode.name: The Briery Gap Theatre and Cultural Centre (Macroom)

name: Y Deis
summary: At the heart of Y Deis is a unique blend of general knowledge, skill, strategy - and a little bit of luck. Three teams of two go head-to-head across several rounds, building their prize pot through quick thinking and smart play. Only one team makes it to the final, where they face a high-stakes quiz against the clock to claim the Jackpot.

name: An Deis
summary: At the heart of An Deis is a unique blend of general knowledge, skill, strategy - and a little bit of luck. Three teams of two go head-to-head across several rounds, building their prize pot through quick thinking and smart play. Only one team makes it to the final, where they face a high-stakes quiz against the clock to claim the Jackpot.

name: The Entrepreneurs
summary:
The Entrepreneurs will spotlight 12 of this year's EY Entrepreneur Of The Year™ finalists, offering viewers unique insights into the highs and lows, and risks and rewards of business. 

Narrated by renowned broadcaster Kathryn Thomas, each 30-minute episode will feature three of this year's finalists, exploring their entrepreneurial journeys, the challenges they've overcome, and the bold thinking that drives their success – embodying the ambition, creativity and confidence that define the island of Ireland's entrepreneurial spirit.

name: Trackers: The People vs The Banks
summary: Trackers: The People vs The Banks is a two-part series that goes behind the headlines to tell the real story of Ireland's tracker mortgage scandal through the eyes of those most affected.

name: Приговор
summary: 22 years ago, Savva got in touch with criminals and was charged with murder. After being released, he decides to give up his criminal past and start a quiet life with his beloved. But someone is clearly against this development of events: Savva is being dragged into a showdown, blackmailed and deprived of hope for a bright future. Blinded by revenge, he decides to investigate his own past and find those who ruined his life. What Savva doesn't know is that the truth will turn out to be much more complicated than he expected.

name: European Qualifiers Preview Show
summary: A look ahead to upcoming 2026 UEFA European Qualifiers.

name: Armored Saurus
summary: The story of dinosaurs equipped with state-of-the-art suits and their pilots fighting against alien mechanical dinosaur corps.

name: Noona, You Are a Woman to Me

previousepisode.name: C'est l'heure du classique : Olympique Novais vs Fontenay le Vicomte

name: Kateikyoushi no Kishi Naito Desu
summary: The story is a heartwarming comedy about "sparkling prince" private tutor Kishi Naito and the hot-headed delinquent Takasugi Toru. Toru's mother, worried about her son's constant fighting and rock-bottom test scores, hires Kishi as his tutor. Though Toru is bewildered by Kishi's gentle and sweet teaching style, he soon finds himself drawn into Kishi's pace — setting the stage for a dramatic transformation in his life.

name: Love Begins in the World of If
summary: Kano Akihito, a reserved man who moved from the technical department to sales, struggles to fit in and feels isolated at work. His relationship with his talented colleague Ogami Seiji becomes strained due to an incident, leaving him torn between admiration and inferiority. One night, Akihito discovers a mysterious mirror at a shrine and he wished that "I want to become someone who can laugh together with Ogami as an equal." The mirror transports him to a parallel world where he's more confident and accepted. In this new reality, even Ogami looks at him differently. As Akihito experiences this ideal version of his life, he begins to confront his true emotions and learns what truly matters in the real world. This is a heartfelt story about self-discovery and love between two people trying to reconnect.

name: Rabbit, Rabbit
summary: When an escaped convict is cornered by law enforcement at a truck stop, he takes hostages in an effort to bargain for his freedom. But the standoff soon escalates into an unmanageable social experiment with his captives — and an emotional poker match with a veteran FBI Crisis Negotiator trained in "tactical empathy."

name: Nissene i skjul
summary: 24 celebrities live together like elves on an abandoned pig farm. But among them is a mischievous elf who is out to sabotage the game.

name: The Front Line
summary: The Front Line follows two half-brothers who couldn't be more different: Malcolm, a serious, rule-following police officer, and Sheldon, a laid-back Rastafarian who trusts his own path over authority. Sharing a home, their culture clashes, sibling squabbles and everyday mishaps fuel the comedy.

name: Rise of Her Lady Physician
summary: Due to a miscarriage of justice, Rong Zelan ventures alone into the inner circles of power, determined to carve her own path in the male-dominated Imperial Medical Bureau. Though scorned by the male doctors, she rises against all odds with her great medical skills. By healing the Crown Prince, saving the Empress Dowager, and quelling a deadly plague, she achieves monumental feats that make her the first female official of this dynasty. She now leads the men who once looked down on her, crafting an inspiring legend of a woman earning her place in the court.

name: MaeBee
summary: MaeBee, brings tales of community, nature and self-growth following the small but mighty adventures of Mae, a determined young gnome with big dreams, and her quirky foster twin Bee, who may or may not realise he's actually a bee. Set in the whimsically unpredictable Green Garden, Mae's mission is to fill her magical Book of BIG with knowledge and grow with every page. With Bee's help (and occasional confusion), Mae tackles challenges head-on, proving that size doesn't matter when you've got heart, curiosity, and a lot of flower snacks.

name: Luna in Dreamland
summary: Luna in Dreamland helps children overcome their fears and anxieties and spark conversations about their feelings, following Luna who enters Dreamland.

name: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
summary: A group of friends are transformed into superheroes. Now, they've got to figure out their powers – and save the day!

name: The Next Step: Cheer
summary: The Next Step's Kenzie salvages what is left of a broken cheer team, desperate to prove that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

name: Holland Drugsland
summary: The Netherlands is and has always been a leader in the drug industry. Our country has long tolerated hashish, cultivated Dutch-grown weed, helped heroin addicts, traded cocaine, and produced ecstasy. Ajouad El Meloudi delves into this history.

name: Gupi
summary: When Gupi moves to a new apartment, she relies on her ingenuity and helpful spirit to make friends with her neighbors and find the fun in her new home.

name: Cometierra
summary: Aylín, a teenager from a working-class neighborhood, discovers her supernatural abilities; when she eats dirt, she has visions that help her search for missing people. Alongside her brother and friends, she embarks on a journey to control this new power. As her abilities grow stronger, she becomes a heroine who stands up against the violence and injustice affecting her neighborhood.

name: Усатые факты
summary: The game is started by three pairs of participants. After the second round, the team with the lowest score is eliminated, and the finalist team is determined based on the results of the third round. The basic prize earned by the winners consists of the sum of points for correct answers. But the final amount of winnings depends on fortune. By rolling a cube with coefficients, players can increase the cash prize by 5, 10, 50 or 100 times.

name: St. Willebrord: Het mirakel van Brabant
summary: Reality series about the close-knit community of St. Willebrord. This once poor village is now thriving. Willebrord residents love big cars, expensive designer clothes, perfect hair, and shiny roof tiles. Parents spoil their children generously, and adapting is the norm. This reality series follows prominent residents at home and at work—in the clothing store, butcher shop, and hair salon. A proud village where traditions and humor collide, and no one ever wants to leave.

name: De Roelvinkjes
summary: At the Roelvinkjes, everything revolves around family. Dries, Dave, Donny, Honoria, Luciënne, and Marijn offer a glimpse into their turbulent lives. Follow the highs and lows of this Amsterdam family.

name: Ta fantasmata
summary: Harris and Marina, a young couple with financial problems, unexpectedly inherit an old mansion in Kifissia. Moving there, they discover that the house is inhabited by nine eccentric ghosts of different eras. When Marina, after a hit in the head, acquires the ability to see and talk to them, begins an unpredictable, comedic coexistence ensues. Greek adaptation of the British BBC series "Ghosts".

name: Natural Disaster
summary: Mohamed and Shrouq's lives are turned upside down due to a rare, unusual pregnancy.

name: Southern Bastards
summary: Southern Bastards follows a tenacious military vet into Craw County, Alabama, in search of her estranged father. What she finds is a murderous hornet's nest of organized crime run by the winningest high school football coach in the South.

name: Roses & Chocolate
summary: Inspired by true events, Marwa, a high-profile TV host, crosses paths with a powerful lawyer live on air. A single spark pulls her into a world where personal feelings collide with public pressure. As the spotlight intensifies and power games escalate, she must decide how far she'll go - and whom she can trust - without losing her voice.

name: Россия 360
summary: Renowned adventurer Bogdan Bulychev is assembling a team to embark on a unique journey in domestically produced all-terrain vehicles across the land borders of the Russian Federation. The first continental expedition begins in Murmansk and will travel through numerous regions of the country, from the Arctic to Kaliningrad. The intrepid travelers will experience changing climates, enjoy diverse and picturesque nature, visit wild, impenetrable places, and immerse themselves in incredible adventures that will require endurance and cooperation. The captivating educational documentary project "Russia 360" was created by the Russian Society "Knowledge" for a wide audience of all ages.

name: A Mission of the Heart
summary: Huang Yu, a strong and spirited girl working as a servant at the Xiafeng Pavilion, accidentally stumbles upon a secret operation by the Jinyiwei investigating a stolen silver case—and becomes the prime suspect of their cold and stoic commander, Lu Zhan. Though she eventually clears her name, her unusual abilities draw Lu Zhan's attention, and she is coerced into joining the Northern Jinfu Si as a junior constable. All Huang Yu wants is to earn enough money to retire peacefully, but her cold-faced boss keeps exploiting her at every turn. With her rare gift for forensic insight, she helps solve a series of mysterious cases, only to uncover the truth of her own past: her family was destroyed years ago by the powerful minister Jiang Ning. As memories resurface, so does her burning desire for revenge. Beneath Lu Zhan's iron-blooded exterior lies hidden tenderness, and he, Huang Yu, and the Minister of Justice Shen Pan become entangled in a triangle of rivalry, trust, and buried emotions. Together, they navigate deadly conspiracies in the imperial court. Amid blades and shadows, Huang Yu and Lu Zhan find love, expose the crimes of the treacherous Zhao Yutang, and clear her family's name. Behind every case lies a web of power and deceit, of love and hatred intertwined. From a streetwise nobody to a fearless game-changer, Huang Yu rises to stand beside Lu Zhan—guarding justice and writing a story of mutual redemption in turbulent times.

name: Project: MKUltra
summary: "The Sopranos" creator David Chase is working on a thriller series at HBO titled "Project: MKUltra."

name: Girlbands Forever
summary: Girl power and killer harmonies. Stars from All Saints, Mis-Teeq and more take a trip through the highs and lows of 90s pop and beyond - from adoration to the flip side of fame.

name: Cenas de Um Crime
summary: A brutal death. Eight interrogations. One culprit. Two detectives investigate a homicide in a mansion where each guest hides a dangerous secret. A terminally ill man is violently murdered during a family reunion and it begs a question: who would kill someone who was already going to die?

name: Koati
summary: Four adorable rainforest animals and their fearless friends go on adventures, learn about nature and discover the power of friendship together.

name: Three Idiots in Kenya
summary: Lee Su-geun, Eun Ji-won and Kyuhyun embark on a dream journey to Kenya — only to find that every meal and adventure is locked behind a wacky challenge.

name: Heweliusz
summary: After a catastrophic ferry disaster, the off-duty captain seeks answers and justice for those who lost their lives — and those they left behind.

name: Simplemente Alicia
summary: Torn between two loves, Alicia secretly marries both a famous writer and a former priest. How long can she juggle love, lies and her double life?

name: Seventeen: Our Chapter
summary: After 10 years together, Seventeen look back at where they've been to uncover where they'll go next.

name: Bake Master Battle
summary: Bake Master Battle is a high-stakes bake-off with three teams of elite bakers competing and showcasing their confectionery mastery in a series of thrilling and festive challenges anchored to seasonal themes.

name: Scammed: Getting Even
summary: Tired of hearing about scammers operating with impunity and destroying lives? Scammed: Getting Even is dedicated to turning the tables on digital criminals. Ashton Bingham and Art Kulik have assembled an elite dream team of tech experts known as the 'Revengers' that traces these criminal organizations back to their source, exposing their fraudulent schemes in real-time. They confront the faces behind the screens, often thousands of miles away, and engineer retaliation.

name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
summary: Two-part documentary, which provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office hit "Avatar: The Way of Water" and a first look at the upcoming "Avatar: Fire and Ash," features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

name: Flaks, ferdig, gå!
summary: The ultimate hunt for Norway's luckiest! 90 children from all over the country compete in fun and spectacular tasks that are based solely on luck.

previousepisode.name: FINALEN: Hvem i hele Norge har mest flaks?!

name: Henki
summary: In 1985, Henki Hauge Karlsen is fired from his bartending job when he chooses to tell his employer that he has tested positive for HIV. He refuses to accept this, goes to court and quickly becomes the face of the "homsepesten" (Norwegian slang/slur from the 80s referring to gay men living with HIV AIDS).

name: Strobe Edge
summary: The gentle and honest high school student, Ninako Kinoshita, had never experienced the feeling of love and spent her days unaware of it. One day, on the train ride home, she meets her classmate Ren Ichinose. Gradually, she finds herself drawn to the hidden kindness within him. Though a painful feeling like something piercing her chest begins to stir, her feelings for Ren grow stronger day by day. Eventually realizing that this feeling is "love," Ninako gathers her courage and confesses her feelings to Ren, but...

name: Due Spicci
summary: When his friend Wild Boar lands himself in hot water with organized crime, Zero and the gang unite to save him while barely coping with their own lives.

name: La Peor Vuelta al Mundo
summary: Having no clue about what traveling around the world entails, Juanpa Zurita convinces Disney+ that he can do it with just a small plane and legendary pilot Matt Guthmiller. Traveling to eight destinations across four continents, with eight celebrity guests to make sure he wouldn't fail alone, and a small budget he managed to get from Disney, it was inevitable this would turn into a complete disaster.

name: Expediente Vallecas
summary: 35 years after the death of Estefanía Gutiérrez Lázaro, the 17-year-old who died under strange circumstances at her family home in Vallecas (Madrid), HBO Max reopens the 'Vallecas File' to investigate what really happened based on the testimonies of her family and the people who know the case best.

name: Звезды под капельницей
summary: "Stars on a Drip" is an anti-alcohol social reality show in which celebrities who have failed to overcome their addictions on their own are sent to celebrity rehab. They will take a break from touring, filming, and their normal lives to undergo a full course of rehabilitation under the guidance of an experienced addiction specialist and his team.

name: The Two Of Them
summary: A heartfelt story about the deep bond and love between two teenage boys — a tale that is tender, pure, and deeply emotional.

previousepisode.name: The Two of Them from My Heart

name: Scav
summary: Every year, a 20-page Scavenger Hunt list plunges the University of Chicago into fun, sleepless chaos.

previousepisode.name: [Final Episode] Reliving the memories of #TOKYO023 on a BBQ cruise

name: Mission: Love Or Lies
summary: Achi, a smart female police captain, is assigned to protect Patty, the daughter of a powerful politician recently targeted in an attack. To stay safe, Patty secretly swaps places with her bodyguard Alice in order to keep the mission under wraps. As Achi works to keep Patty safe, she starts to feel something more than just duty. Love begins to grow—slowly, quietly—in the middle of danger. But strange things begin to happen, and Patty and Alice are both hiding something.

name: Reykjavík Fusion
summary: Talented chef Jónas, falsely imprisoned, tries to regain his family's trust. Shunned by society, he accepts illicit funds to open a restaurant, leading him to money laundering. This jeopardizes his parole, life, and loved ones.

name: PlutoCharon
summary: Yang You accidentally crosses into a parallel universe on the day of a lunar eclipse, becoming a soul entity. He can only materialize within 200 meters of Chen Shi, and to survive, he has no choice but to stay close to Chen Shi. During their time together, Yang You discovers that despite Chen Shi's tough exterior, he is unusually caring toward him. Gradually, Yang You falls for Chen Shi and boldly confesses his feelings. However, just as he decides to give up on returning to his original world, he realizes that Chen Shi knows too much about him, even things he never mentioned. His reporter instincts lead him to suspect he is trapped in a carefully orchestrated scheme.

name: Heroes Next Door
summary: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but solely to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

name: Rainbow Rumble
summary: Rainbow Rumble is ABS-CBN's latest trivia game show hosted by Luis Manzano, where five players race to reach the peak of a color pyramid in a bid to advance to the jackpot round for a chance to win one million pesos.

name: Gorilla School
summary: A glimpse into the lives of gorillas and their relationships with humans in an experiment that has never been attempted before.

name: Pandamonium
summary: Incredible tales of wonder and woe are told as the staff at China's Wolong National Nature Reserve struggle daily to preserve one of the most popular yet endangered species on Earth -- giant pandas.

name: A Fazenda
summary: Eva and her sisters live humbly in Lisbon, unaware that their lives are about to take an unexpected turn. When Gaspar, a wealthy businessman based in Angola, suddenly dies, he leaves his entire fortune to the three young women, who overnight become the owners of a great fortune and an entire estate in Angola. However, not everything will be a bed of roses: they will have to confront Talu, a young Angolan engineer who was excluded from Gaspar's inheritance in favor of Eva. And despite being in opposite sides, neither Talu nor Eva will be able to resist the strong attraction they feel for each other. Among the breathtaking landscapes of Angola and the modern business world of Portugal, the young lovers will find themselves at the center of a web of antagonistic interests, in the dispute over Gaspar's inheritance.

name: Schattenseite
summary: Cyberbullying and hacker attacks change the lives of the main characters shortly before their high school graduation. Corvin, Nola, Patricia, and Simon are actually looking forward to their future beyond school, but then the "shadow side" appears and changes everything. The website reveals the teenagers' most intimate secrets, and the more people click on it, the more explosive material comes to light. Nothing remains taboo: chat histories, screenshots, nude photos, and videos are suddenly accessible to the public. There's only one chance to stop the leaks: the person affected must cooperate with the "shadow side" – and simultaneously betray their closest friends. Does this all have something to do with the recent death of classmate Linus?

name: Play for Today
summary: Inspired by the iconic Play for Today format, each production will champion new voices and focus on bringing low-income talent into the spotlight behind the scenes in writing, directing and production roles.

name: Noen Lyver
summary:
Every year, five families meet at an idyllic summer destination. But this summer is anything but idyllic.

One year after Linnea disappeared, the families return. Linnea is still not found – and when her cell phone turns up, lies and guilt are forced to the surface. Noen Lyver(en: Someone is Lying) is a suspense series about friendship, love – and trust. Because who can you really trust when family secrets are revealed and loyalties are broken? And what do you do when the safest people in life may be the ones you should fear the most?

name: Brennpunkt: Lakselandet
summary: Salmon farming has become a successful industry. But beneath the surface lies a sea of suffering, conflict, and illegal exports. Do we really have control?

name: Skavlan & Sverige
summary: Fredrik Skavlan takes the temperature on his neighboring country, Sweden. An entertaining and engaging show with topical interviews and debates, guests from very different worlds – and a presenter without voting rights.

name: Stoltenberg i møte med krigen
summary: A rare and human insight into the corridors of power. Award-winning portrait of the former NATO chief Jens Stoltenberg, the limited docuseries extends beyond the "Facing War"-documentary with more insights and never-before-seen scenes.

name: Fortnite x The Simpsons
summary: Springfield and Fortnite universes converge. Chaos ensues as Homer sets out to transform the world, wielding a powerful alien energy.

name: Sonic Judgement
summary: The story follows experienced detective captain Su Lingyu and audio-visual department head Jiang Cheng, who team up to solve a series of complex cases and grow together through the process. The investigation begins when a brutally tortured male body is found at a steel factory — the only clue being a mysterious recording seemingly staged by the victim himself. Fifty catties of gold have gone missing, and a kidnapping victim has vanished without a trace. As the police dig deeper, they uncover the victim's own web of crimes, including school bullying, fraud, sexual bribery, and loan sharking. Meanwhile, a long-buried family massacre resurfaces. Things escalate when Su's ex-girlfriend witnesses her former lover bleeding from all seven orifices and on the brink of death. A "black widow" commits a string of murders by poison and passion. At Xingsheng Hospital, a corpse disappears from the morgue — only for the former deputy director's body to later be found inside. As Su Lingyu and Jiang Cheng pursue the truth, the investigation exposes a vast criminal network and an unexpected mastermind behind it all. Through their unwavering teamwork and determination, they not only bring the perpetrators to justice but also uncover the truth behind the mysterious death of Jiang Cheng's parents, ultimately dismantling the entire crime syndicate.

name: The Hillside Strangler
summary:
The Hillside Strangler explores the infamous murders that gripped Los Angeles in the late 1970s and the exhaustive investigation that followed. 

In the late 1970s, Los Angeles was the serial murder capital of the world. The Freeway Killers. The Toolbox Killers. The Dating Game Killer. The Skid Row Slasher. But none terrorized this city of millions more than the Hillside Strangler, a phantom who struck without warning, abducting, raping, and murdering a dozen women and girls and leaving their bodies displayed on the hillsides like grim trophies. These crimes sparked the largest manhunt in LA's blood-soaked history, led by a relentless homicide detective named Frank Salerno. His dogged pursuit led to the strangler's capture and the revelation that these vicious acts were perpetrated by two men, Kenneth Bianchi and his cousin Angelo Buono.
